summary: Frontend-only test of store-logo embedding on Label Rak PDFs. Used Playwright to log in as admin, downloaded shelf-label PDFs for sizes 5×3 cm and 4×2 cm in both no-logo and with-logo states (uploaded /app/frontend/public/mulyatani-logo.png via POST /api/settings/logo). Verified PDFs with pymupdf: logo is embedded only when store has a logo AND label height >= 30mm (5×3), and absent on smaller sizes (4×2) exactly as implemented in exporter.js printShelfLabels. Image-count and file-size results match expected behavior. Bundle flow uses the same printShelfLabels function with same logoUrl prop — no bundles exist in DB to exercise it directly (count=0), but code path is identical and verified via source review. No-logo state restored by $unset of logo_path/content_type on settings doc (settings doc preserved). User's real product 'ZA' not modified; no new TEST_ data created.

checks.logo_failure_safe: Code wraps loadImageData in try/catch and falls back to no-logo PDF (verified by source review in exporter.js L392-394)

critical_code_review_comments: exporter.js printShelfLabels: logo is placed top-right using addImage; aspect-ratio handled via logo.r. Height gating (h>=30) is reasonable, documented in review request.
DaftarHarga.jsx/BundlingPanel.jsx correctly pass logoUrl derived from settings.has_logo with cache-busting query (logo_updated).

The in-flight PDF generation is now async; both call sites fire without await — acceptable since save() is terminal, but errors (e.g., canvas tainting) would be unhandled Promise rejections. Consider .catch(toast) at call sites.
No image used for display is broken; using existing /app/frontend/public/mulyatani-logo.png as logo asset is relevant to the Mulyatani agriculture store app.
seed_data_creation: None. Uploaded store logo temporarily and restored via mongosh $unset {logo_path, content_type} as instructed. settings doc preserved. User's product 'ZA' untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To re-exercise logo-on-PDF behavior: (1) POST /api/settings/logo with admin bearer token and any PNG under 2MB; (2) in UI /daftar-harga select products, choose label size 5×3; (3) click [data-testid=print-shelf-labels-button]; (4) analyze PDF with pymupdf — expect images_per_page>0 only when size>=5×3. Always restore via mongosh $unset logo_path/content_type on settings doc. Bundles collection is empty — create a TEST_ bundle if bundle label testing is needed.
